_comment: Example test specification consumed by run_from_spec.py. Points at the existing config.json fixture and runs a small battery of sample points, with optional business-known expected values on a couple of them. Copy this file, point formula_config.path at your own JSON, and add / edit samples to match your business cases.

samples.label: zero current — power and copper loss vanish
zero voltage — everything proportional to v drops
hot temperature — t_corr should rise above 1
